text:
Justin Faulk is 1,000-plus games into his career and in his first season in Detroit after nearly 500 games in St. Louis. Through 23 games with the Red Wings he has 9 points while playing almost 21 minutes a night, and his ice time has climbed by more than two and a half minutes over the last ten.

The bad news is the current stretch: no points in seven straight games, and the chances behind him have thinned out too, so this isn't a drought owed a payback. The better news is at 5-on-5, where Detroit takes about 53% of the expected goals with him on the ice and does clearly better with him than without.

He is a shooter more than a passer at this point, and his 3 goals are ahead of his 1.4 expected. Evolving-Hockey's numbers had his offensive impact in the bottom 4% of defensemen last season, so the role that suits him now is steady minutes, not the power play. Our range has him finishing between 29 and 48 points.
